2.88.5 Chart.CategoryAxis
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Chart.CategoryAxis element specifies the category axis for a Chart. This element is optional.
This element is of type CategoryAxis.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.CategoryAxis element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.CategoryAxis element.
 <xsd:element name="CategoryAxis" type="CategoryAxisType" minOccurs="0" />
